checks.check: Publisher CSV display headers map to declared field names
checks.observed: {'Date received': 'date_received', 'Product': 'product', 'Sub-product': 'sub_product', 'Issue': 'issue', 'Sub-issue': 'sub_issue', 'Company': 'company', 'State': 'state', 'Submitted via': 'submitted_via', 'Company response to consumer': 'company_response', 'Complaint ID': 'complaint_id'}
checks.expected: every declared source field has a canonical publisher header match

checks.check: CFPB annual CSV exposes required ID, time, population, label and feature fields
checks.observed: ['Date received', 'Product', 'Sub-product', 'Issue', 'Sub-issue', 'Company public response', 'Company', 'State', 'ZIP code', 'Tags', 'Submitted via', 'Date sent to company', 'Company response to consumer', 'Timely response?', 'Complaint ID']
checks.expected: contains complaint_id, date_received, product, company_response, sub_product, issue, sub_issue, company, state, submitted_via

checks.check: Annual CSV exports are complete and not truncated at the export cap
checks.expected: each year between 1 and 99999 rows, below the publisher 100000-row CSV export cap

checks.check: Population product filter uses publisher product value
checks.expected: rows with product equal to Checking or savings account included; other products excluded

checks.check: Requested annual event windows return parsed rows
checks.expected: zero unparseable dates among product rows; each year 2019 through 2023 represented with at least 5000 rows

checks.check: Label mapping uses exact terminal disposition strings
checks.observed: {'response_counts': {'Closed with explanation': 128260, 'Closed with monetary relief': 26236, 'Closed with non-monetary relief': 8434, 'Untimely response': 53}, 'unknown_or_nonterminal_excluded': {}, 'scored_rows': 162983}
checks.expected: Closed with monetary relief maps to 1; recognized other terminal dispositions map to 0; in progress, blank and other responses are excluded

checks.check: Stable complaint IDs and event times are nonmissing and unique in scored rows
checks.expected: zero missing and zero duplicate complaint IDs; zero missing event times

checks.check: Missing categorical values remain blank and are never zero or literal nan
checks.expected: zero literal nan strings; blank strings are allowed for optional intake fields

checks.check: Fixed chronological half-open splits are nonempty
Every scored row falls in exactly one fixed split
checks.expected: sum of split row counts equals scored row count

checks.check: Split boundaries are respected without row crossover
checks.expected: train below 2022-01-01; eval from 2022-01-01 to below 2023-01-01; holdout from 2023-01-01

checks.check: Constructed files contain exactly declared columns
Written event timestamps are timezone-naive and inside the declared half-open split windows
checks.expected: every constructed time string parses without a timezone offset and lies within the declared train, eval and holdout windows

checks.check: Target is binary and unknown outcomes are not negative labels
checks.expected: target values subset of 0 and 1; unknown outcomes excluded

checks.check: No post-intake label or disposition field is used as a feature
Calendar features are deterministic functions of the event date
checks.expected: every month matches the parsed month and every weekday matches the parsed day name

checks.check: Complaint IDs do not overlap across the three fixed splits
Constructed rows are sorted deterministically by event time and ID
checks.expected: each split is nondecreasing by date_received

checks.check: Constructed CSV files exist and are nonempty
checks.expected: each output file larger than zero bytes
